note: Beach campground on the Pacific behind the park's own dunes, at the end of unpaved Davison Rd (3 mi north of Orick off US-101). No trailers; a 23-ft self-contained motorhome fits. Two vehicles at most in a site's parking space, extras in the overflow lot. Roosevelt elk graze the campground; Fern Canyon is a short drive north (campers need no Fern Canyon permit). --Claude
summary: Agency pages + ReserveCalifornia read: $35, 26 sites, 24-ft/8-ft vehicle limit, no trailers, no hookups, potable water + pay showers, first-come in winter (Nov-Mar this year), reservations from Apr 1, open year-round. Coastal dunes confirmed (own dune field, ~150-180 m to surf, no road between).
